# {{ brand.name }}

> {{ seo.SUMMARY }}

Two services, sold on their own or together:

- GTM Engineering: {{ site.GTM_FEE }} a month for a promised number of meetings with the buyers a client wants to meet. We watch for buying signs (posts about the problem the client solves, requests for recommendations, competitors' audiences, tenders, company news, new leaders, visits to the client's website, events), write to the people who fit by email and LinkedIn in the client's name, handle the replies and book meetings into the client's calendar. Only meetings that take place, with someone who fits the profile agreed on the first call, count. Each missing meeting is credited on the next bill, at the monthly fee divided by the number promised.
- Performance Marketing: Google Ads (Search, Shopping and Performance Max) and Meta, checked every day by {{ paid|length }} agents, with every change made by a person on our team. Paid on results; the result and the rate are agreed after a free account audit of about 50 checks.
